The full record isfree with an accountor through the [API](https://indexed.vc/docs/api). ## About AmplifAI is an AI-powered performance management platform built specifically for contact centers, founded in 2014 by Sean Minter and headquartered in Plano, Texas. The platform unifies structured and unstructured data from voice, chat, CRM, QA, and workforce management systems into a single performance layer, then delivers role-specific insights and AI-recommended next-best actions to frontline agents, team leaders, and senior executives. With over 10,000 CX teams as customers including The Home Depot, AmplifAI drives measurable improvements in agent productivity, coaching effectiveness, automated quality management, and overall customer experience outcomes. Summary It lists 51–200 employees. It has raised $50.1M in total across 3 rounds, most recently a $33.7M Series B round in Sep 2025. Investors include LiveOak Venture Partners, CVS Health Ventures and Greycroft.
